notes:
Champagne rooms.

- When starting a champagne timer you can tap the room on the floor plan (optional). Rooms 1 and 4 hold two girls, 2 and 3 hold one; a full room can't be picked.
- The Champagne tab on the iPads shows the rooms with who is in each and the time left. Room... moves a girl to another room.
- When a girl's time is up, starting someone new in her room stops her timer.
- The room shows on the DJ screen, the alerts, the night report and the Excel download.
- Change the rooms in Settings > House fees & champagne.
